subject: general
question: Madhvi started her journey at 9:25 am and covered 24% of the distance by 9:39:24 am. At what time will she reach her destination if she continues at the same speed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Madhvi completes 24% of the distance in 14 mins and 24 sec

⇒ (14 × 60) + 24 = 864 sec

So to cover 1% distance time required = 864 / 24 = 36 sec

According to the question, Madhvi travels at the same speed,

Time required to complete 100% distance = 100 × 36 = 3600 sec

⇒ 3600 sec = 60 mins = 1 hour

**∴ Madhvi will reach her destination at 10.25 am**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

24% of journey covered in = 14 mins = 864 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Speed of Madhvi is constant along the journey,

Speed of 24% journey = Speed of whole journey

If the total journey is 100% then 

⇒ Speed of 24% journey = (24)/864 .............(1)

⇒ Speed of whole journey = 100/t ...............(2)

⇒ t = 100/0.0277

⇒ t = 3610.10 sec = 60.16 min

**∴ The time taken time by her to reach her destination is 10:25 am.**
